project_type: Python robotics reliability platform — MuJoCo simulation + ROS 2 nodes (separate)
test_framework: pytest with testpaths=['tests'], markers: unit, integration, edge_deploy
build_command: No explicit build step — pure Python. 'pip install -e .' for editable install.
verification_instructions: Run `python3 -m pytest tests/ -v` from /root/forge. All 328 existing tests must pass plus new tests for Phase 11 modules.
environment_constraints: Running in WSL Ubuntu at /root/forge. MuJoCo rendering requires MUJOCO_GL=egl for headless. No physical hardware. onnxruntime/torch optional (lazy imports). ZERO ROS dependency in forge_core/.
contribution_requirements: forge_core/ has ZERO ROS dependency. Everything YAML-driven. Match existing dataclass + JSON/YAML persistence patterns. Lazy imports for heavy optional deps. Tests use tmp_path fixtures. CLI scripts add project root to sys.path.

key_patterns.dataclass_style: Use @dataclass with to_dict()/from_dict() classmethods for serialization — see DeviceInfo in fleet.py, UpdatePackage in ota.py
key_patterns.config_loading: YAML files in config/, loaded via forge_core.config.load_yaml(). PROJECT_ROOT from config.py.
key_patterns.test_style: Tests in tests/unit/test_*.py. Use pytest classes (TestXxx). Use tmp_path for file-based managers. Import with sys.path hack at top. No fixtures file — inline helpers.
key_patterns.cli_style: Scripts in scripts/forge_*.py. argparse with subparsers. sys.path insert at top. Logging config. Main guard.
key_patterns.module_docstrings: Top-level docstring with module purpose. 'Phase N — FEAT-NNN.' at end. Section separators with # ── Title ──
key_patterns.manager_pattern: Manager classes take optional dir Path, default to PROJECT_ROOT / 'subdir'. _load/_save JSON persistence. Sequential ID generation (_next_*_id). ValueError for not-found.
key_patterns.policy_interface: Policy ABC: reset(sim: ForgeSimulation), act(sim: ForgeSimulation) -> np.ndarray, done -> bool, name -> str

directory_structure: forge_core/ — core Python modules (no ROS); ros2_ws/ — ROS 2 nodes; simulation/scenarios/ — YAML scenarios; tasks/ — task YAML; faults/ — fault profiles; config/ — YAML configs; scripts/ — CLI entry points; tests/unit/ — pytest unit tests; tests/integration/ — integration tests; docs/ — architecture.md, setup.md; README.md at root
